annotations.title: Roll up what a workflow takes

description: Per run and per month: hands-on minutes, waiting minutes, labor cost (hands-on time priced through each role's hourly rate), and hard costs, each as a low–high range, with every step's share and its gates (approvals, handoffs, re-keying, rework). A step that is itself a workflow uses that workflow's roll-up unless it has its own estimate. `coverage` says how many steps are timed — always say how much of the total rests on estimates before quoting it, and never present a range as one number. `unpricedRoles` are roles doing timed work with no hourly rate; their time counts and its cost doesn't. Where the waiting dwarfs the hands-on time, or a gate rarely sends anything back, is usually where the improvement is. `at` reads the estimates as of a date; `variantId` rolls up one variant.

at.description: How things were on this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default today.

changeIds.description: Project the workflow as these changes would leave it (ids from compass_scenario_changes). Compare with a call without them: before vs after, what stays human, overlapping changes.

knownAt.description: Count only what had been said by this date — the picture as we knew it then.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: compass_workflow_rollup
